description: This source file defines configuration options for a distributed RPC backend using the TensorPipe framework in PyTorch. It includes classes and functions for setting device mappings, RPC timeout, number of threads, and other backend-specific options.

classes.name: TensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Defines configurable options for the TensorPipe RPC backend in PyTorch's distributed module, allowing customization of threading, timeout, device mapping, and device list.

methods.name: torch.device _to_device(device: DeviceType)

methods.description: Converts a mapping of devices from one form to another, ensuring one-to-one correspondence and returning a dictionary suitable for internal use.

methods.name: list[torch.device] _to_device_list(devices: list[DeviceType])
